verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an accounting SaaS could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), and the developer portal returns 403 to non-browser agents, so no agent-readable docs could be found. An introspectable GraphQL endpoint is a developer building block, not agent-oriented documentation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
